verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own fetch capability converts any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown, which covers part of the story's format range. The evidence is a single marketing line, and it does not show how a developer selects the format or that plain text or frontmatter are offered. Missing for 10: plain-text output, frontmatter output, documented format-selection parameter, API reference depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose exactly which output format is returned, such as markdown, HTML, text, or frontmatter

citations.quote: Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
